summary: Final frontend retest of the translation items left open in iteration_34. Tested on the mobile web preview at 375x667 in ar/en/de/zh/he, with the autoT cache cleared, plus code and dictionary checks. FIXED: competition/[id] shows '10000 participants / Teilnehmer / 名参与者', and the last quiz button reads 'Submit answers' / 'Antworten absenden'. LoyaltyRedeemPicker program names are translated at runtime (de 'Store-Punkte (intern)', zh '店铺积分（内部）'), the sheet title is translated, and its labels use textAlign 'auto' (start in LTR). PaymentAndLoyalty uses textAlign 'auto'. 'My addresses' is correct in en/de/zh. 'Customer address' and 'Pickup type' are correct. The loyalty card shows 'Redeem' / 'Einlösen'. Plurals '(2 questions)', '(2 Fragen)' and '0 employees' are correct. The zh shipping-matrix carrier shows 沙特邮政. tSync with trimmed keys works: de 'Keine Reservierungen Mit Status "Bestätigt"' and live-preview '(5 Preise)'. The merchant bookings back arrow points left in en/de. The create-return, marketing, product-analytics, warranty, social post-type and services-catalog category labels are wrapped. STILL OPEN or NEW: customer social commenting is broken. Every POST /api/social/posts/{id}/comments returns 500, because all 56 posts store comments as an array and the backend runs $inc on it. The comment is saved, but the user gets an error alert and the count never updates. Other remaining strings: competition-form type names are raw Arabic and 'Type *', 'Name *', 'Phone *', 'Password *' are hardcoded English. 5 EmptyState description/actionLabel props are unwrapped (team, pos, branches). services-catalog module names and loyalty-programs catalog show raw name_ar. live-preview has the raw competition_type 'general', 'Subscriber' for participants, and raw platform labels. product-form condition pills are raw Arabic. 7 more back buttons use a hardcoded chevron-forward (pointing right in LTR). There are several wrong dictionary entries. Regression: about 120 page loads (customer zh/he, merchant he/en, chamber and driver in all 5 languages) gave 0 pageerrors and 0 red screens. Deprecated Expo packages: none found.

critical.issue: Returns 500 for every post. pymongo WriteError: 'Cannot apply $inc to a value of non-numeric type' because all 56 social_posts have comments as an array (server.py:1215). The comment row is inserted before the crash, so the frontend shows an error Alert, setPosts never runs and the count does not update. The same mixed int/array type also causes TypeErrors in deep_analytics.py:366 and server.py:5890/5902/5945/5957 (backend.err.log).
STILL PRESENT (out of scope, re-listed): it has no auth. An unauthenticated curl returned 200 and actually ran the draw on 6ab6206a71b6ad54069c12be during this test.

minor.issue: STILL PRESENT (re-listed): it reflects any Origin (https://evil.example) together with allow-credentials: true.

There is a stale wrong zh entry for 'البريد السعودي (سبل)': '中国邮政（沙特邮政）' (hash 1f37638cad4c..., created 2026-10-25 13:09). The static dict overrides it in tSync, but any /api/translate caller still gets the wrong value. Delete it or overwrite it with '沙特邮政 (SPL)'.

critical_code_review_comments: The social_posts.comments field has a mixed type (array in seed data, int expected by the increment code). This is the root cause of both the earlier merchant social crash and the current 500.

Many screens render backend catalog fields (name_ar/description_ar) directly. Catalog data that ships with the code (shipping providers, modules, loyalty programs) should use name_en, or a language map, for non-ar.
live-preview.tsx is well over 1500 lines and should be split.

rca_of_issue: Social comment: seed data stores social_posts.comments as a list of comment objects, but add_comment runs $inc {comments: 1}, which raises a Mongo WriteError (code 14) and returns 500 after the insert. The frontend catch shows an Alert and skips setPosts. Repro: log in as the customer, open /social, tap a comment bubble, type text and send. The Network tab shows POST 500. Mitigation: use $push, or store a separate comments_count field.
